import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D

D2R = np.pi/180.0

def rot_axis(v, axis, ang):
    axis = np.asarray(axis, float); axis = axis/np.linalg.norm(axis)
    v = np.asarray(v, float)
    c, s = np.cos(ang), np.sin(ang)
    return v*c + np.cross(axis, v)*s + axis*np.dot(axis, v)*(1-c)

def unit(v):
    v = np.asarray(v, float); return v/np.linalg.norm(v)

# ---------- global frame ----------
Co = np.array([0,0,0.0])
Pc = np.array([0, 2.25, 0.0])          # central phosphoramidite P (up, in plane)
Hh = np.array([0,-1.50, 0.0])          # hydride (down, in plane)
Cc = np.array([0, 0, 1.78])            # carbonyl C (toward viewer +z)
Oc = Cc + np.array([0,0,1.16])
Pl = np.array([-1.95, 0,-1.13])        # left PPh2 (back)
Pr = np.array([ 1.95, 0,-1.13])        # right PPh2 (back)
Oe = np.array([0, 2.85, 1.45])         # ether O on Pc (wedge, +z)

coords = {}
coords['Co']=Co; coords['Pc']=Pc; coords['H']=Hh; coords['Cc']=Cc; coords['Oc']=Oc
coords['Pl']=Pl; coords['Pr']=Pr; coords['Oe']=Oe

# ---------- diazaphospholane ring ----------
# ring: Pc - Nl - Cl1 - Cl2 - Nr ; N above P, CH2 up top
Nl = np.array([-0.85, 3.35, 0.05])
Nr = np.array([ 0.85, 3.35, 0.05])
Cl1= np.array([-0.78, 4.60, 0.75])
Cl2= np.array([ 0.78, 4.60, 0.75])
coords['Nl']=Nl; coords['Nr']=Nr; coords['Cl1']=Cl1; coords['Cl2']=Cl2

# ---------- isopropyl on Oe ----------
CH = Oe + np.array([0.35, 0.85, 0.85])
CF3a = CH + np.array([1.35, 0.35, 0.35])
CF3b = CH + np.array([-0.55, 1.45, 0.55])
coords['CH']=CH; coords['C1a']=CF3a; coords['C1b']=CF3b
def cf3(C):
    Fs=[]
    for d in [(1.0,0.3,-0.6),(-0.3,1.0,0.5),(0.1,-0.6,1.0)]:
        Fs.append(C+unit(d)*1.35)
    return Fs
F1 = cf3(CF3a); F2 = cf3(CF3b)
coords['F1']=F1; coords['F2']=F2

# ---------- phenylene rings ----------
def ring(center, n1, n2, tag):
    """hexagon with C1 at n1 direction, C2 at n2 direction from center; planar."""
    n1=unit(n1); n2=unit(n2)
    bis = unit(n1+n2)
    C1 = center + bis*1.396
    C2 = center + bis*1.396
    # build in-plane axes: e1 = bisector, e2 perpendicular in plane
    e1 = bis
    # plane normal from n1,n2: they are 60 deg apart in-plane
    e2 = unit(n1 - n1.dot(e1)*e1)
    pts=[]
    for k in range(6):
        ang = k*60*D2R
        pts.append(center + e1*(1.396*np.cos(ang)) + e2*(1.396*np.sin(ang)))
    # rotate so pts[0] aligns with n1: find index closest to n1 dir
    dots=[p.dot(n1) for p in [q-center for q in pts]]
    i0=int(np.argmax(dots))
    pts = pts[i0:]+pts[:i0]
    # ensure pts[1] close to n2 else reverse
    if unit(pts[1]-center).dot(n2) < 0.5:
        pts = [pts[0]]+pts[:0:-1]
    for k,p in enumerate(pts):
        coords[f'{tag}C{k+1}']=p
    return pts

# left phenylene: C1 bonded to Nl (ipso-N), C2 bonded to Pl (ipso-P)
# ring center: place so that C1->Nl and C2->Pl bonds ~1.4/1.8
# start: center between mid of Nl,Pl pushed away
midNPl = 0.5*(Nl+Pl)
d = Nl-Pl
